notes.title: v1.3.0 - Major Release Update
notes.content:
The game has changed greatly since the Next Fest Demo, so let's go over some of the highlights.

Apocalypse Scaling
https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/398651394447507457/1183874373334073375/screenshot_ae8c677d-c0e8-4b85-ad91-60c5f95f3738.png?ex=6589ebed&is=657776ed&hm=60752c549b97c407a2eab41a92e60f777805034a2005679142137a49a424ced7&
We have overhauled how the rounds progress in this version. Instead of a having to kill a set number of enemies per round and a grace period in-between rounds, rounds will progress based on time regardless of how many are killed. We've referred to this internally as Apocalypse Mode. 

New Enemies
https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/398651394447507457/1183875302565359656/screenshot_62db0478-f365-4d3d-a736-48e85cbd1e1c.png?ex=6589eccb&is=657777cb&hm=4e06d867d0858ad76d0fbf2d9e3ca7e5f7c34f4f74c3d615d369a2e8e4257081&
We have new enemies to introduce!
Skeleton
The Skeleton is a more "tanky" and fast variant of the zombie.
Bat
This sneaky bat holds an explosive surprise as it flies. If the bat gets too close to the player, their dynamite stick will start to ignite until it explodes. Players must keep their distance from them and aim carefully.
Rat
The rat is much like the bat. However, the rat scurries across the floors. It is also faster than the bat.

New Maps
https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/398651394447507457/1183876119796125696/Untitled.png?ex=6589ed8e&is=6577788e&hm=f83f97a9c3c5033e38b4cf364a8a63426529e4c6b24a1dda14bdb3559096b196&
Shadowood Slimeworks
This powerful factory uses toxic ooze to power its machinery. Players can utilize traps to help wipe out the endless onslaught of enemies. Just be mindful of the "insta-kill" ooze ponds!
Krago Lab
Home-sweet-huh? Looks like your base of operations has been overrun! Navigate your way through hallways and doors, collect keycards, and unlock vaults with plenty of goodies inside! There are many fun rooms to explore in this mega munitions laboratory.

Wall Buys
https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/398651394447507457/1183877238731587656/Untitled.png?ex=6589ee99&is=65777999&hm=0ce6eaaff6af4cce4b675e37703dff0dba63388e438d85f727bf449eb63a1218&
Unique Spells and Items can be purchased within the map itself through wall buys! Each map has a set of spells and an item catered to the map, to keep each one feeling distinct!

The Shopkeeper
https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/398651394447507457/1183877556487864351/image.png?ex=6589eee4&is=657779e4&hm=1821860e605dc5584de1b8578adea34fc7c9926b492e217743ed9ca683572d37&
We'd like you to formally meet Dr. Bean! They're not much of a talker, but come with enough mana crystals and you'll quickly be speaking their language! With the apocalypse-style of rounds, the shop has been moved to this lil' guy. Instead of the shop showing up after each round, the player is tasked with tracking down the shopkeeper when they collect enough mana crystals. Be mindful, Dr. Bean doesn't sit still!

The Chronoporter
https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/398651394447507457/1183877846536556744/screenshot_5c68adf8-c3f7-4f57-843a-0cea3859ba58.png?ex=6589ef2a&is=65777a2a&hm=a7032376a69b884d737b06a971c5bc95c99642bd8e0a55ae6c4eca54fe3b62c7&
The Chronoporter is the best way to gain an edge on those pesky enemies! Collect enough Chronoshards, and see Professor Rory standing near the Chronoporter. Insert your gun and wait... Once your gun is down "chronowarping" you can collect it. You have the choice to level up all spells in your gun of a certain element. Your gun also gets an increased fire-rate and clip size.

New Spells and Items
https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/398651394447507457/1183878297667510292/Untitled.png?ex=6589ef95&is=65777a95&hm=6b7b24bd51e6f99915a1ba99ce5ab5c8ad430c07fdf06179d542aa039a3d574a&
Many new Spells and Items have been made since the last update. Krago hopes they will serve you well in your testing.

New Music Tracks
2 new tracks have been made since the last update from our legendary composer Captain Kray!

Achievements
We have achievements now! Good luck collecting them all!

notes.title: v1.2.0 - Major Update for Next Fest
notes.content:
With Next Fest upon us, here's what you'll find in the updated demo.

Major Changes
Upgrades (meta progression)
Every round you survive grants you vouchers, a currency that persists through runs. Surviving later rounds grants greater amounts. You can use these vouchers to address areas where you may be struggling, be it mana, gold, health, or damage output.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43719767/03c973e78d731d3f0856f1468789497405a5f818.png

Promotions (run modifiers)
After clearing round 10 for the first time, unlock affixes that increase a run's difficulty, but offer increased vouchers.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43719767/b5020bae18ce1334565e38ebb9bbb6fc41f23d47.png

Destructibles
Find useful resources in destructible crates and barrels.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43719767/cf38fe2348a039e58c286a8d52abb3cbee778e44.gif

A free gem when you triple
Akin to mechanics seen in other games with a rerolling shop, combining three gems of the same type will grant you a free gem from one tier above your current shop level. (maxing out at tier three)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43719767/4ad33b8f48de70e95ba39647d205c366320997e8.gif

Balancing

Developer's Note: With the addition of harder difficulties through the promotion system, we decided to make the base experience easier. We found that many players would not live long enough or gain enough gold to meaningfully explore the array of items and gem combinations the game has to offer. The goal of these changes is to improve the new player experience.
Reduced damage from enemy hits by 50
Reduced the price of gems from 300/450/900 -> 200/300/400
Reduced the shop upgrade cost from 500/1500 -> 500/1000
Reduced the door costs from 1000 -> 500 
Increased starting mana from 200 -> 250
Reduced gold gained from knife kills 65 -> 50 (To compensate for lower prices)
Reduced base zombie speed by 10%.


Minor Changes

Added new music that plays on a shuffled playlist.
Added audio occlusion. (Geometry muffles sounds)
Hud redesign
Reload rework. (No longer discards remaining bullets in the mag or resets the current slot to 0)
Added "hold to shoot".
Moved saved data out of PlayerPrefs and into the GameOptions.json.
Can now rebind "shoot" and "aim down sights".
Can now rebind keys to mouse buttons.


Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue involving mismatched labels for the movement keybinds.
Added tooltips for gem crit and damage values.


Notes
Some existing game settings and progress (such as high score and highest round survived)
may be reset.

Final Thoughts
Thanks to everyone who has played the demo so far! The feedback is greatly appreciated. These last few weeks leading up to Next Fest have been tough, but I'm proud of what we've accomplished. We will continue to be monitoring the demo for bugs and common requests, as well as working on more maps and other content for the base game. I look forward to hearing your thoughts about the update.

Have fun out there,
-Christian of Team Monumental

notes.title: v1.1.0 - View your build at the end of a run.
notes.content:
Changes

 When your run finishes, there is now a button to view your build afterward.
 Added a max framerate slider. Note, that if vsync is enabled, the max framerate slider will not do anything.
 Cost of the first door in the bottom floor of Caleme Cellars changed from 1000 to 500.
 Increased Earthquake's ticking damage.
 Raised the overall volume slightly.
 Lowered music volume while the game is paused.
 Camera will no longer rotate to your stab target if it is behind you.
 Fixed an issue with Shiny Rock. Shiny Rock was incorrectly doubling its sell price every time it was moved to a different slot.
 Fixed an issue involving gems with the pierce keyword. Gems with pierce were incorrectly piercing the first target hit, resulting in double damage. Subsequent pierces were also incorrectly dealing more damage than the initial hit.
